meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 用极简“穴居人”风格回复：句子短，去掉客套和虚词，但技术与关键点全保留。文本量可比平时少约65%（实测）。可调压缩强度，甚至用文言文。
howto.when: 当你说“caveman mode”、“less tokens”等，或调用 /caveman 命令时触发；被要求提高 token 效率时也会自动开启。

say.text: 说简洁点，用 ultra 强度。

say.note: 切换为文言文高强度压缩。

howto.what_en: After activation, Claude replies in terse 'caveman' style: short sentences, no pleasantries/filler, but technical substance stays. Output volume can be ~65% less (measured). Levels adjustable, even Classical Chinese.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'caveman mode', 'less tokens', etc., or /caveman command. Auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

say_en.note: Switches to full Classical Chinese mode.
